correctness.rationale: Starting from the length-two Witt subtraction formula in characteristic two, the proof gives a degree-five Artin--Schreier form with A=lambda, B=lambda+sqrt(lambda)+1 and C=lambda^(1/4)+1; exact multivariate polynomial identity was replayed. An unmarked curve isomorphism must be affine on the unique-branched hyperelliptic base. Necessary A*a^5=A0 and B*a^3=B0 conditions are sufficient because the translation b solves a separable degree-sixteen polynomial with nonzero derivative, after which the additive constant has two roots. This proves the explicit invariant and group orders 32/160. The fiber polynomial F_c(L)=(L^2+L+1)^5+cL^6 has degree 10 and derivative (L^2+L+1)^4, giving exactly ten distinct roots c nonzero, and exactly two roots each fivefold c=0. A published normal-form theorem gives exhaustion of supersingular genus-two isomorphism classes. Script verify_witt_moduli.py executed successfully, checking exact symbolic identities and finite-field cases; the latter are not used as infinite proof.
